title: Space Station HUD Visor Simulation
description: The user is inside a space ship hallway and must locate, pick up, and equip a pair of high-tech smart sunglasses that activate an augmented-reality HUD overlay. Once equipped, the visor reveals hidden diagnostic panels on the hallway walls that the user must interact with to restore ship power.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (via importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net) that implements a first-person space station visor simulation. Load both GLB assets using GLTFLoader: space_ship_hallway.glb as the environment and SunglassesKhronos.glb as an interactive pickup object. Place the camera inside the hallway at one end using a first-person perspective. Add PointerLockControls so the user can look around with the mouse and move with WASD keys. Place the sunglasses model on a crate or floating mid-air near the hallway center, slowly rotating with a subtle glow using a PointLight. Add ambient light (intensity 0.3) and two directional lights for moody sci-fi lighting with a blue-purple tint. Interaction steps: (1) The user walks toward the sunglasses using WASD. (2) When within range (distance < 2 units), a text prompt appears on screen saying 'Press E to pick up visor'. (3) The user presses E to pick up the glasses, which attaches them to the camera as a child object positioned at the lower portion of the view like wearing them. (4) Upon equipping, apply a green-tinted post-processing effect to the renderer by overlaying a semi-transparent green CSS div with pointer-events none, and spawn 3 glowing rectangular panels on the hallway walls (simple BoxGeometry with emissive green material). (5) The user walks to each panel and presses F when close to activate it, changing its color from green to blue. (6) When all 3 panels are activated, display a centered success message 'Ship Power Restored' with a fade-in animation. Add a HUD-style HTML overlay showing status text like 'Visor: Not Equipped' that updates to 'Visor: Active — Panels Remaining: X'. Ensure the hallway model is scaled appropriately so the camera fits inside it. Add fog with a dark blue color for atmosphere. Include click-to-start pointer lock activation.
